_comment: Pin for the python-build-standalone (astral-sh) CPython runtime used by build.ps1.
STATUS: PLACEHOLDER — sha256 (and probably release_tag) MUST be pinned before first release.
1. Open https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases and pick a dated release tag.
(install_only_stripped is smaller; plain install_only also works — it must contain python.exe + Lib/).
3. Set 'url' to the asset download URL and 'python_version' / 'release_tag' to match.
4. Download the asset once, compute SHA-256 (PowerShell: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256),
cross-check against the SHA256SUMS file attached to the same GitHub release, and set 'sha256'.
build.ps1 refuses to run while sha256 starts with 'REPLACE_ME'.
